اغتصبوا (form VIII)
# اِغْتَصَبُوا (iḡtaṣabū) /iɣ.ta.sˤa.buː/: third-person masculine plural past active of اِغْتَصَبَ (iḡtaṣaba)
# اُغْتُصِبُوا (uḡtuṣibū) /uɣ.tu.sˤi.buː/: third-person masculine plural past passive of اِغْتَصَبَ (iḡtaṣaba)
# اِغْتَصِبُوا (iḡtaṣibū) /iɣ.ta.sˤi.buː/: second-person masculine plural imperative of اِغْتَصَبَ (iḡtaṣaba)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
